verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no bulk or batch operation capability, such as batch API endpoints, bulk actions on inquiries or accounts, or mass import and update. Workflows automate decisions per trigger, and recurring report schedules run against an account on an interval. Both are adjacent automation features and a recurring schedule, not one-off bulk operations across many items, so neither counts for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
